slides.title: The sore one.
slides.body: Still sore from Tuesday. It is Saturday. Tuesday was mobility.

slides.title: The weather report.
slides.body: Too cold. Too hot. Light drizzle, possibly, at some point.

slides.title: The big week at work.
slides.body: Third big week in a row. Work has never once been small.

slides.title: The home workout.
slides.body: Will train in the lounge room instead. Watches a video about training.

slides.title: The early cancel.
slides.body: Cancels at 9pm for a 6am class. Just in case they don't feel like it.

slides.title: The deload.
slides.body: Calls it a deload. It has been three weeks.
